name: Cognitive Complexity of methods should not be too high
description: High cognitive complexity usually means one unit is coordinating several concerns; look for a hidden boundary to extract.

name: Methods should not be too complex
description: High cyclomatic complexity signals branching logic that may belong in separate policies or a domain service.

name: Methods should not have too many lines
description: Long functions tend to mix orchestration with business rules; split along the boundary they cross.

name: Classes should not have too many methods
description: Classes with many methods usually own more than one responsibility; split along the boundary.

name: Classes should not have too many fields
description: Many fields indicate a class aggregating state that belongs to several components.

name: Methods should not have too many parameters
description: Long parameter lists suggest a missing contract or value object at the boundary.

name: Classes should not be coupled to too many other classes
description: High efferent coupling signals cross-module leakage or a missing abstraction at a boundary.

name: Functions should not have too many lines of code

name: Files should not have too many lines of code
description: Oversized files often hold several modules' responsibilities; split by ownership boundary.

name: String literals should not be duplicated
